title: Whole Open Tailgate Round Chamber and Pickup Baler
description: One independently authored whole empty towable round-baler-inspired apparatus in a fixed display pose. A full low twin-wheel frame and converging draw beams support a thick front semicylindrical chamber, complete side cheeks and a full rear curved shell raised about an upper cross pin. Its real empty curved inside and lower rollers are exposed rather than a black disc or enclosed bale. A separate low horizontal pickup drum with complete support cheeks and blunt comb teeth sits under a whole shallow front visor. This is not the old rectangular long-hand-lever press reshaped or a combine with its cab deleted: all visible geometry is newly authored for this complete low front pickup/large round rear chamber/raised curved tailgate relationship. One model zero scenes, four opaque matte PBR materials. No crop or bale. Static visual exterior only: no gathering, feed path, compaction, bale formation, power, towing, articulation, hydraulic motion, manufacture, load, human fit or agricultural safety capability. Rigging animation interaction not made.
